parameters.name: CheckParams
parameters.description:
The parameters for the baseline risk item that you want to fix.

*   **checkId**: the ID of the check item that corresponds to the baseline risk item.

*   **rules**: an array that consists of the rules applied to fixes.

    *   **value**: specifies whether a fix method is selected. Valid values: **0** and **1**. The value 0 indicates that no fix method is selected and the value 1 indicates that a fix method is selected.
    *   **ruleId**: the ID of the fix method.
    *   **paramList**: an array that consists of the details about the fix method.\
        • **paramName**: the name of the fix method.\
        • **value**: the value of the fix method.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: RetentionDays
parameters.description: The retention period of the snapshot that is created when you fix the baseline risk. Valid values: 1 to 365. Unit: days.

parameters.name: RiskId
parameters.description:
The ID of the risk item.

>  To query the information about the risk items and check items of a server, you must specify the IDs of the risk items. You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~) operation to query the IDs of risk items.

parameters.name: SnapshotName
parameters.description: The name of the snapshot that is created when you fix the baseline risk.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description: The UUID of the asset for which you want to fix the baseline risk item. You can call the [DescribeWarningMachines](~~DescribeWarningMachines~~) operation to query the UUIDs of assets.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas fix-check-warnings --source-ip 165.225.XX.XX --lang zh --risk-id 10354 --check-params checkId_:8,_rules_:_ruleId_:_rule.ssh_Idle.interval_,_value_:1,_paramList_:_paramName_:_range_val_,_value_:_600_,_paramName_:_range_val_,_value_:_600_,_ruleId_:_rule.ssh_Idle.count_,_value_:1,_paramList_:_paramName_:_range_val_,_value_:_3 --uuids 75a417dda5f25edb5bed8f208a9a0000,c7e10fd794262a1510d5648f9e5d0000 --snapshot-name sas_fix_2024-12-04 --retention-days 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
